description: cbbackupmgr-compact.md states compacting backups is 'no longer supported/required' for backups created with cbbackupmgr 6.6.0+, 'due to changes in the storage format which significantly reduced backup fragmentation'. cbbackupmgr-backup.md's native cloud integration feature was introduced in the same version, 6.6.0. Neither page states whether the two are related - a storage-format change large enough to make an entire command unnecessary, landing in the same release as a new cloud-writing capability, is exactly the shape of an undocumented wider rework, and no page describes what changed or why the two coincide.
